doc.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Born in Detroit; parents and his name
summary: Harris was born in Herman Kiefer Hospital in Detroit; his parents were Bessie and Melvin, and he likes his name.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born in Herman Kiefer Hospital in Detroit. You know, so Detroit was really my home, you know for quite a few years.
So, mother and father. What’s your mother and father’s names?
Mother’s named Bessie, father’s named Melvin.
Alright. So who named you? Do you know who named you – your name is Barry Doyle…
Don’t ask me. Probably my mother.
Probably the two of them together, maybe. You know.
So um, that’s how I got my name.
Oh, positively. Positively, you know. See I’d say that your name is what makes you what you are, sometimes. So I – what I have become is partly due to the name, you know.
